text: Not bad, some are very off, being the smaller the prop or whatever the worse the image is. besides that though, i like this approach yes. i hate everything else about how this entire panel is working though. the pills for categories. the pills for for pills of categories. but i understand t hat was not your first task. so yeah. uhm. this is better. its acceptable. the rest of everything around it is not
resolution: Fixed the prop picture-browser thumbnail quality complaint: smaller props rendered worst. Root cause: PropBrowser.solveThumbCamera framed each tile from the prop kind's DECLARED heightMeters/footprint and assumed the model spans 0..h centered at the origin. Any declared-vs-actual mismatch or off-anchor geometry is a fixed error that becomes a large FRACTION of a small prop, so small props floated tiny/off in their tile. Added propVisualBounds(kind) to compile/propRecipes/footprint.ts — the prop's full visual AABB over every recipe part with rotation baked in, reusing the existing partLocalBox + boxSpan helpers — and reframed the thumbnail from its true centre + bounding-sphere radius. Declared dims remain the fallback only for imported/cooked meshes that have no recipe parts to measure. The 'I hate the pills' half of this message became its own task (req_1906, decouple BUILD from PROPS) and is in review separately. Built clean via SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int. Needs a live rjit dev look to confirm small props now fill their tiles.
